items.title: Kenneth Walker: Likely out in Week 11
items.description:
Head coach Andy Reid said Friday that Walker (groin) "most likely" won't be available Sunday against the Cardinals, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: T.J. Hockenson: Good to go for Week 11
items.description:
Hockenson (wrist) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday night's game against the 49ers.

items.title: Drake Maye: Out indefinitely with fractured fibula
items.description:
Maye has suffered a fractured right fibula that won't require surgery but is expected to sideline him for some time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Expected to miss multiple weeks
